## Monitor brand hashtag mentions on Instagram and alert via Telegram

### How it works

This workflow runs on a 15-minute schedule or manually for testing, searches configured Instagram hashtags through an external API, and checks whether the response is valid. It deduplicates mentions using workflow static data so only newly found posts are routed onward. Depending on the route, it sends either a test summary, a live Telegram alert, or an error notification when the search or response fails.

### Setup steps

- Configure the hashtags and Telegram chat ID in the "Configure Your Search" node.
- Set up the HTTP request credentials or API key required by the RecentReborn Instagram hashtag search endpoint in the "Search Hashtag" node.
- Connect Telegram bot credentials for all Telegram notification nodes.
- Run the manual trigger once to test the search, validation, deduplication, and Telegram delivery before enabling the 15-minute schedule.

### Requirements

- A RecentReborn API account (app.recentreborn.com) with an API key

### Customization

Adjust the polling interval, hashtag list, alert routing conditions, Telegram message templates, and deduplication logic to match the brand monitoring requirements.

## Start monitoring run

Entry points that start the workflow either automatically every 15 minutes or manually for testing.

## Prepare hashtag search

Defines the search configuration, splits the comma-separated hashtags into individual items, and sends each hashtag to the Instagram search API.
